tooltip.sculkhorde.blade_of_purity.funct: §7§oA weapon that upon striking a Sculk Horde mob, will give it the purity effect and purify the surrounding land.
tooltip.sculkhorde.blade_of_purity.lore: §7§oA weapon imbued with the warm and embracing aura of purity. Holding it fills your body with the resolve to restore balance to a corrupted world. All anguished souls will know peace once they meet this weapon.
info.thermal.hazmat_armor: Protects from various hazards. Wearing the full set provides infinite Purity.
tooltip.sculkhorde.calcite_clump.functio: §7§oObtained from mining §e§oSculkspar Ore§f§7§o from a §e§oLiving Rock structure§f§7§o.
tooltip.sculkhorde.calcite_ore.functiona: §7§oCan be obtained from §e§oLiving Rock Structures§f§7§o surrounding §e§oSculk Nodes§f§7§o.
tooltip.sculkhorde.sculk_sweeper_sword.l: §7§oA special sword designed to kill swarms of Sculk Mobs. The blade is forged from the cleaver of a §7§oSculk Interloper§r§7§o.
tooltip.sculkhorde.sculk_enderman_cleave: §7§oThe blade from the cleaver of a §7§oSculk Interloper§r§7§o. It is used to craft §7§oThe Sculk Sweeper§r§7§o.
§7§oIt appears to be made of a sculk-ified bone-like material. Extremely sharp and tough like metal.
sounds.sculkhorde.raid_scout: A distant Sculk Interloper scouting out a raid location.
